summary: TIME AI iteration 2 (frontend-only, viewport 390x844). Verified every requested area: performance, tab switching, new Privacy/Terms pages, Clock (stopwatch/timer/focus), keyboard-aware forms, form validation, graceful notification handling on web, Agent happy/odd/empty paths, Hub modules, Settings theme, data persistence. Launch: /tabs/today becomes interactive in ~0.73s (no JS spinner screen). Tab switches: ~0.32-0.37s. Clock sw-start/sw-lap/sw-stop, timer-preset-1 + timer-start/timer-pause, and focus-start/focus-stop all tick and respond immediately. Keyboard: pressing Enter in field-title (text input) moves focus to field-due as expected; final text field submits via onSubmitEditing. Validation: empty title -> 'Title is required.'; due 'abc' -> 'Due: use format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm.'; past reminder -> 'Reminder time must be in the future.'. Future reminder saves and toast reads '⚠ Task saved, reminder: System notifications are not available here; reminder kept in-app.' - no crash on web. Agent: 'asdf qwerty' and empty input produce no error overlay; 'add task Essay by friday 2h' + agent-approve-all-button creates the task and it appears on /tasks. Hub shows 21 modules, hub-module-notes/goals/wellness open without crashes. Hub footer hub-privacy-link and hub-terms-link navigate to privacy-screen and terms-screen; both pages contain support email jarvisai9077@gmail.com and privacy-screen-email-button / terms-screen-email-button. Settings > About tab exposes settings-privacy-link, settings-terms-link, settings-support-link (all present, support email visible). Settings theme-dark / theme-light toggle instantly. AsyncStorage persistence verified after full reload (TEST_KBD_Task still present). No React Native red screen, no deprecated expo-router warnings observed in this run (migration from unstable-native-tabs complete).
critical_code_review_comments: src/legal.tsx cleanly centralizes SUPPORT_EMAIL (jarvisai9077@gmail.com) and LegalPage component; both /privacy and /terms consume it, keeping copy and testIDs consistent.

src/ui/overlay.tsx TextInput wiring is correct: returnKeyType='next' + submitBehavior='submit' + onSubmitEditing walks to nextKey (text/number/date/time/datetime fields), and the last textual field submits the form - verified end-to-end in the task form.
clock.tsx refactor: only the display component re-renders on tick; interaction buttons (sw-*/timer-*/focus-*) remain responsive. No stutter observed during 1s+ runs.
engine/notify.ts correctly degrades on web - instead of throwing it surfaces a toast informing the user that the reminder is kept in-app. Good UX fallback for the web preview.
seed_data_creation: TEST_KBD_Task (task with future reminder), 'Essay' task via Agent approve-all flow. Both persisted across reload. Note: because the form was submitted multiple times intentionally while probing validation, two TEST_KBD_Task rows may exist - this is a test artefact, not an app bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844. All tab routes live under app/(tabs); tab-* testIDs only exist on (tabs) screens, so when verifying tab switches navigate to '/' first (not /tasks or other stack routes). Clock sub-sections are selected by chip text (Clock/World/Alarms/Timer/Stopwatch/Focus) before the sw-*/timer-*/focus-* testIDs become visible. Form validation errors are rendered under [data-testid='form-error']. Top submit button is form-submit-top-button (preferred on long forms); fallback is form-submit-button at the sheet bottom. Notes 'add' first opens a template picker, not a title form - choose a template to reach the field-title step.
rca_of_issue: No app bugs found this iteration. Previous iteration 1 LOW-priority item (form-submit-button offscreen on 844px viewport) is resolved by the added form-submit-top-button; it is now the first clickable submit control, so no scroll_into_view is required.
